items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: In the meantime now we have set Charlie Carpenter up in New York with William Morris' office.

ctx.x: It had just opened, this great show, 'Jump for Joy.' And of course Ben Webster, being Ben, was hanging out every night, so a funny thing happened. Ben said 'how much you making a week, man?' Well, by this time -- oh, I'm a little ahead of myself. When we organized this band, we had to set up salaries, so we set up the salary for the men, at $7.00 a night. Bill Eckstein and myself were making $10.00 a night, and it was understood that -- Earl said you and Billie did this for me, you're going to make as much as…
Now, mind you, Earl had nothing -- no control over the money. In the meantime now we have set Charlie Carpenter up in New York with William Morris' office. Charlie--
: Charlie Carpenter is now manager for George Kirby.
